reason: It is a wait that yields the running thread, like TriggerSleepAction and PolledWait, and the lint plugin bans it with them; a Wrapper member would offer that wait as a safe call.
source: common.j declares it beside TriggerSleepAction in the trigger action API; eslint-plugin-reforged's data/unsafe-natives.json (rule no-unsafe-natives) bans it with TriggerSleepAction and PolledWait for killing the thread outside a trigger action.

reason: It returns nothing for the item it creates when the inventory is full, the unit cannot carry items or it is dead, although the item exists on the ground; Unit#addItemById calls CreateItem and UnitAddItem instead, so it returns that item (#261).
source: jassdoc on UnitAddItemById: "If inventory is full or unit is dead then the item is dropped on the ground at unit position", returning "null if inventory is full, unit cannot carry items" (https://lep.duckdns.org/jassbot/doc/UnitAddItemById)
